messages:
emma_partners: Quick heads-up  Vertex Retail signed a co-sell + Azure Marketplace listing today and greenlit a short joint case study.

rory_sales: Nice!! Any measurable wins from their integration pilot?

leo_engineering: Pilot highlights: turned on per-route KV caching + fine-grained quant profiles. Result: ~52% reduction in GPU-hours for their price-quote pipeline and p95 latency down from ~810ms to ~260ms on real traffic.

zia_marketing: Love the numbers. Do we have permission to use logo + a 1-line quote? Need assets for blog, tweet, and partner page.

legal-bot: Marketing consent form signed and uploaded to Docs.

emma_partners: Confirmed. Vertex wants a gated case study and a short public announcement. They also requested a co-hosted 30-min webinar next month.

rory_sales: Can someone add a one-pager for AEs highlighting procurement via Azure Marketplace and reserved capacity options? Makes follow-ups easier.

leo_engineering: I'll prepare a 2-line tech blurb and export the latency dashboard. Also will attach a tiny snippet showing the caching config (`route_cache:
  prefix: /quotes
  ttl_ms: 5000`).

zia_marketing: Planning: blog + gated case study + webinar. I'll draft copy and post to #marketing-review by Wed. Need the dashboard shot and quote by EOD Tue.

ops-bot: task created: "Vertex Retail marketplace + case study"  assignees: zia_marketing, leo_engineering, rory_sales. Due: 2026-11-05. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/5057

emma_partners: We'll call this out in the all-hands next week as a marketplace momentum win. Thanks team :tada:

rory_sales: Big win for Q4 bookings. :clap:
